sections.heading: Painting a picture of the past
sections.body:
Besides habits, the imperfect is the tense for **description** in the past: what people and places were like, what time it was, the weather, how people felt, how old they were. Think of it as the scenery of a story.

- People: *Mi abuelo era alto y tenía el pelo blanco.* (My grandfather was tall and had white hair.)
- Places: *La casa era vieja y tenía un jardín enorme.*
- Time and age: *Eran las diez de la noche. Yo tenía ocho años.*
- Weather: *Hacía frío y llovía.* (It was cold and it was raining.)
- Feelings and states: *Estaba cansada. Tenía hambre.*

sections.heading: Physical description words
sections.body: Hair: *tener el pelo* + *largo* (long), *corto* (short), *rubio* (blond), *castaño* (brown), *negro*, *rizado* (curly), *liso* (straight). Eyes: *tener los ojos* + *azules, verdes, marrones / cafés* (brown). *Llevar* means to wear: *Llevaba una chaqueta roja.* Also *llevar barba / lentes* (to have a beard / wear glasses — *gafas* in Spain).

sections.heading: Asking about how things were
sections.body: *¿Cómo era tu casa?* (What was your house like?) *¿Cómo era tu profesor?* *¿Qué tiempo hacía?* (What was the weather like?) *¿Qué hora era?* *¿Cuántos años tenías?* (How old were you?)

examples: Mi abuelo era alto y tenía el pelo blanco.
My grandfather was tall and had white hair.
La casa era vieja y tenía un jardín enorme.
The house was old and had a huge garden.
Eran las diez de la noche.
It was cold and it was raining.
Ella tenía el pelo largo y rizado.
He was wearing a red jacket.
Mi profesor llevaba lentes y tenía barba.
My teacher wore glasses and had a beard.
It was small but very pretty.
Hacía sol y no había nubes.
It was sunny and there were no clouds.
Mi hermana era rubia y tenía el pelo liso.
My sister was blond and had straight hair.
El chico tenía el pelo corto y castaño.
The boy had short brown hair.
Hacía mucho calor en la ciudad.
It was very hot in the city.

exercises.prompt: Ella tenía el pelo ___ y rizado.
Why is it *Eran las diez* and not *Fueron las diez*?
options: Telling the time in the past is description → imperfect

exercises.prompt: Which asks "What was your house like?"
Which tense describes the weather in a past story?
exercises.explain: The preterite *hizo frío* is possible when summing up a whole period (*Ayer hizo frío*), but for scene-setting use the imperfect.

exercises.prompt: It was cold and it was raining.
Put the words in order: "The house was old and had a huge garden."
exercises.answer: La casa era vieja y tenía un jardín enorme.

exercises.answer: Mi profesor llevaba lentes y tenía barba.

exercises.answer: Hacía sol y no había nubes.
